technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with multiple overbought conditions and new highs, but extreme RSI/Stoch readings and Ichimoku cloud positioning create significant pullback risk; suitable for aggressive traders only.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 86 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying activity (2 purchases vs 1 sale, small amounts) lacks conviction; market fear (40 Fear/Greed score) presents contrarian opportunity but absence of recent news sentiment and neutral AAII reading prevent confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (338.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures energy multinationals, FOMC event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; earnings 86 days out provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 94.77 extreme overbought with Donchian 20 new high and AO cross-up create aggressive short-term momentum setup, and fear-zone market sentiment (40 Fear/Greed) offers contrarian opportunity for tactical entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 94.77, Stoch 95.48) combined with price below Ichimoku cloud, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 86 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD headwind) create unacceptable reversal and drawdown risk.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI extreme overbought (94.77) with Donchian new high and AO cross-up create short-term momentum, but price below Ichimoku cloud signals intermediate weakness. Fear-zone sentiment offers contrarian angle, but macro headwinds and zero fundamental support make risk/reward unfavourable.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 94.77, Stoch 95.48) combined with VIX crisis levels and FOMC event in 2 days create imminent reversal risk; earnings in 86 days add material uncertainty with no offsetting catalysts.
